about: The Prusa machines whose converted CAD ships in the build: where printer X0 Y0 Z0 is in the model's frame, the printer's axes in that frame and the motion group that carries the plate, in the form of printer-print-frames.json.

prusa_core_one.basis: From the model's CAD and its registered calibration (X0 is the plate's left edge, Y0 its front edge, Z0 the sheet touching the nozzle): the nozzle tip is at CAD -1.17, -57.94, 329.00 in the pose (the lowest point of the hotend), the head moves -130.24, -87.07, 0.00 and the bed 0.00, 0.00, 250.56 to reported zero, so printer 0,0,0 is CAD -131.41, -145.01, 78.44 and the sheet's top (78.44) is there. The margins of the plate on the sheet are the CORE One L's, measured in F02; here they are estimates.
